title: McRimworld Workshop Experience Specification
description: Declarative description of a playable RimWorld experience: identity, dependencies, desired game behaviour, and the verification status of each part. Produced by a ChatGPT design session and consumed by Claude Code / the Workshop launcher.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the document was written against.

id.description: Stable slug for the experience, e.g. 'lantern-village'. Used as the manifest filename and profile name.

version.description: Semantic version of this experience's design, independent of schemaVersion.

summary.description: One or two sentence pitch of the experience.

status.description: Overall status of the experience as a whole.

mods.description: Every mod the experience needs, Workshop-subscribed, locally built, or vanilla-adjacent.

customMods.description: Mods that must be built from source inside this repository (e.g. a sibling of mods/the-ark-rimworld), rather than installed from Workshop.

sourcePath.description: Path relative to the repository root, e.g. 'mods/vampire-lord'.

buildProject.description: Path to the .csproj to build, relative to the repository root.

loadOrder.description: Experience-level load-order hints layered on top of each mod's own loadAfter/loadBefore.

sequence.description: Explicit, fully-ordered list of packageIds. When present this takes precedence over per-mod constraints for ordering (constraints are still validated).

launch.description: How the experience is started and resumed. 'desired' fields describe target behaviour (e.g. one-click new game); 'implementation.status' must not claim beyond what M4 has actually delivered.

verification.description: What must be true for this experience to be considered working, and how each level is checked.

requiredLogLines.description: Substrings expected in Player.log when the experience loads correctly.

runtimeChecklist.description: Manual steps a human runs to runtime-verify this experience.

lastVerifiedAt.description: Date of the last successful runtime verification, if any.

featureStatus.description: specified = described only; implemented = code/config exists; runtime_verified = observed working in a live RimWorld session; blocked = cannot proceed, see notes.

packageId.description: RimWorld packageId as it appears in About.xml / ModsConfig.xml.

workshopId.description: Steam Workshop file id, if sourced from Workshop.

source.description: workshop = Steam Workshop subscription; local = user-installed outside Workshop; builtin = DLC/core, no separate install.

dependsOn.description: packageIds this mod requires to also be active.

behaviourSection.description: Separates desired game behaviour from how (or whether) it has been implemented.

desired.description: Free-form description of the intended behaviour. Structure is section-specific and intentionally loose at M1; later milestones may tighten it.

files.description: Repository-relative paths implementing this section, once status is implemented or later.
